newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA C. BANK CUTS SPECIAL 3-MTH T-BILL RATE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA C. BANK CUTS SPECIAL 3-MTH T-BILL RATE.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it had lowered the rate of its three-month special series Treasury bill to 14.20 percent from 14.80 percent.
The rate cut came after the central bank slashed its overnight borrowing rate by two percentage points to 18 percent earlier in the day.
Traders said the central bank wanted to send a signal that it wanted T-bill rates to decline in the coming auction on Monday.
